article.title: Execution of sentence of death passed by High Court
article.content: When a sentence of death is passed by the High Court in appeal or in revision, the Court of Session shall, on receiving the order of the High Court, cause the sentence to be carried into effect by issuing a warrant.
article.html:
454Execution of sentence of death passed by High Court

Section 454 · Chapter XXXIV · Death sentences

When a sentence of death is passed by the High Court in appeal or in revision, the Court of Session shall, on receiving the order of the High Court, cause the sentence to be carried into effect by issuing a warrant.
